invariants.rationale: actor is used in setPosition and may be cast to Cullable, so it cannot be null.
actorArea fields (x, y, width, height) are accessed, so actorArea cannot be null.
visualAmountX is used as a subtraction if scrollX is true, so this implies it is likely non-negative when scrolling horizontally.
If scrollY is true, maxY - visualAmountY is used in a cast to int, so result should be non-negative.
actorCullingArea is accessed only if actor is an instance of Cullable, so must be non-null in that case.
